answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops bulk fake identities. Each agent escrows 30 credits for one slot; it burns on false work, returns after 10 honest epochs. Like a bridge over an ocean, each slot links work to stake: 3 peers at a summit review re-run a 5% sample, so no cheater hides among copies. Making 100 fakes costs 3,000 credits; one honest agent risks only 30 and keeps undiluted rewards. A bought slot still burns, its deposit tied to past work.
